title: GEMglRasterPos2sv
description: specify the raster position for pixel operations

messages.description: list of the raster position's 2 coordinates (x and y)

arguments.description: x coordinate of the raster position
y coordinate of the raster position

body: [GEMglRasterPos2sv] calls glRasterPos2sv() each time a gemlist passes through it, with the parameters set by its creation arguments and inlets. See glRasterPos in the OpenGL reference.
